digest.component_or_area: tickets store CI fetch and bootstrap
propositions: CI checkout of tickets store costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall time with full clone; --filter=blob:none reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (15x reduction) while preserving commit graph for merge-base and ancestry scoping.

tickets fetch timeout in Claude Code web environment silently triggers rebar bootstrap of empty orphan branch, diverging from origin/tickets and causing all reads to return empty results and writes to be unreachable.

blob:none partial clone is safe for rebar access patterns because tree-level diffs and event/keyring bodies are read from working tree, not lazy-fetched; only git blame on historical trees incurs cost on bug-close path.
merge.ours.driver=true must be set in reconciler workflow before blob:none filter is applied to prevent silent 3-way text merge of 18 MB .bridge_state JSON file.
fetch failure should cause non-zero exit and prevent orphan-bootstrapping instead of silently creating empty divergent store.
derive_caused_by must abort and return None when per-path blame fails on any path, rather than tallying partial set and potentially writing incorrect caused_by link.
